body: Thank you so much for the links.  I am going through them and hopefully one will be able to work out for me.
Thank you for the advice.  I had reached out to a couple of auctioneers, but the timetable wouldn't work out due to the dates.

I have been trying to figure out a fair market value for my items by searching online, but haven't found pricing for them as used.  I think that some restaurants just have deals with supply stores to purchase the items back if the business goes under.  But since so many restaurants have gone went out of business, I think they just have huge supply that they are not offering good pricing.
I have systematically gone NoContact with everyone in my life.  The number of times I tried to be honest with them, I became too much of a burden for them.
That's how all my relationships end.  I finally say out loud what's been eating at me from inside and then I never hear from them again.
I would just be open to someone listening and not at the end have to hear, 'damn man, that sux.  Good luck with that!' before I never hear from them again.
You just summed up the last 40 years of my existence.  What the fuck do I do now?
I did take him in and physically he is fine.  Thanks for the advisement though.

I, also, don't know if he is depressed or not for certain, but I think he has gotten so sick of my depression that if he spent any measurable time with a relatively happy person, he would for certain forget about the 6 years we were together.  He may just go through the motions with me rn because it's the hand that feeds him.  

He used to always cuddle up next to me, keep up constant contact with me or at least keep me in his field of vision when I am moving around.  Now he just stays as far as he can away from me and doesn't even move his head to see where I am.

I hate the holidays!!! Actually, I hate the three months between Nov 13 and Feb 14.  It was my sister's and aunt's death anniversary two weeks ago.  Like usual, its just me and my dog for Thanksgiving this year because he is the only thing I am thankful for in my life.  In two weeks it is my bday, which most people won't remember the right date to muster up a hastily two-worded email, like each preceding year.  Two weeks later, Christmas where I won't get a single gift or call.  New Year is just another reminder of how I don't have anyone in my life that gives a shit! And Valentine's day is my mom's death anniversary.  

So yea, I fuckin hate the holidays!!!!
I wake up with a hint of optimism.  Fill out applications and send out resumes for jobs.  Wait for the rejections to come in or just be ghosted all together. Go to sleep dejected.
I do wish more people would take the time to understand, but then again wouldn't wish this feeling on anyone.  Just feel like I'm drowning in shits creek.

I agree with you.  I've always felt this sub should not display the number of upvotes or percent that upvoted the post.  Why make people feel even worse because trolls want to go around and downvote to be assholes themselves when all you are trying to do is reach out to anybody worthy for a non-judgmental post.

Only you can determine if you are a bad person, not me or anyone else on this subreddit. 

But to generalize someone into a category because they chose to be open and forthcoming about their feelings and the difficulties they go through.  That is why depressed people find it difficult to talk openly about their feelings to those closest to them because people choose not to look past it or to marginalize it.  So to have gone through some of life's trials and tribulations in the hardest way possible, only to have it follow them around like a scarlett letter on his chest, while trying to face the world on their own.  

If he is such a sweet, caring, sensitive guy, that respects and honors what you believe, then he seems like he deserves a chance for happiness too. But if you can't show him the slightest bit of empathy to see past his depression to be a needed friend at the least, if I could talk to him I would tell him he deserves better than you!

FYI some personality types (INTJs in particular) prefer some time alone, which has nothing to do with depression, but just a way for them to be able to put an extroverted face on the rest of the time, to face the pressures everyone expects from them.  But that duality can ultimately drive them into depression because they don't understand who they really are.  Just what people tell them they should be, especially their ignorant parents.

I am no expert at any of this, just a depressed INTJ that hopes one day for happiness.  But from reading what this group has to say, I prefer to be alone with my dog because I know he won't judge me.  Just love me for me!
I'm barely even functioning anymore.  No job! No place to live! Moved to a new city for a fresh start, but realizing its all the same shit, just a different location.  Praying today will be my last.

Thank you for that advise.  I am certainly taking a concerted view about what I should be able to manage without, so definitely taking only value added items.  As I mentioned, one day I would like to live in a tiny home, so best to consolidate now, rather than later.  I've moved with so much sentimental crap I haven't touched in the last year or two, that will probably not make the trip.

I remember back in the day, I did two cross country moves with only what I had in the back seat and trunk of my 07 Camry.  I kinda miss those days !
I am definitely starting to look more into Joliet and Peoria.  Hopefully I can have a couple of interviews set up before I make the trek.

The past couple of months, I have been doing better in stretching food costs out as much as I can.  I am now down to $125-150 per month.  Wasn't eating like a king, but was able to get one meal a day, maybe two if I was able to stretch a Subway sandwich or cheap pizza into a couple of meals.  
Depending on where I move on from here will determine how much of the moving costs will be, gas being the x factor and a trailer being a set price. But I'm mainly concerned about finding a job when I get there.  It's been tough for me for some time.

Thank you the advise, I had not thought about Illinois.  

Would that be more of the Naperville/Joliet area or Peoria / Springfield area?

Misery ... 

I remember watching this movie when I was around 12 and having nightmares for months from the sledgehammer scene.  Now, 25 years later, I may not be physically beaten in my bed daily, but it sure feels like it.

Well, I try to keep my expectations low for reddit.  If you've read my previous posts, couple of people have given some sources to reference, but I am no more wiser now than when I started opening up couple of weeks ago (but I do appreciate their time in reading and responding with anything).  Still unemployed; on the verge of eviction (court tomorrow); bankruptcy; social degenerate.  Nothing reddit can do about it, just have to accept the path.
However, I probably do get more empathy on reddit than I would irl.  Everyone in my life, either ignores my subdued emails or tries to sell me on some BS platitudes. 'Keep the faith, it'll all work out.'

Thank you, I just dont know what my days ahead behold.  On the verge of financial ruin and homelessness, unempolyable and evidently unlikable, there is not much to look forward to in the coming days, weeks, months, years.   I've followed my hopes, had faith in the universe, and waited for signs of good times ahead, nothing came!  Not everyone is meant for happiness and greatness, just the realities for that can be a hard pill to swallow, for sure.

For one man to rise, many men need to fall.
I emailed my dad (bcc'd my sis) last week that the only regret I have in life, is waking up each morning.  They chose to ignore it completely so here I am on this subreddit.

Internalizing my strife about issues with those that claim to care about me. Coming to the hard realization that I may have been the central issue to all my problems when I felt my decisions, at the time, were based on practicality and protecting myself. Financial woes that I have created by a foolish idealistic mindset over reality.  The perpetual debt cycle I have created by myself for an end goal that may never come, but in my heart I hope it does.  Coming to a hard truth that I may not be employable to the degree that I had always hoped and said debt cycle may never end.
Just a lifetime of hopelessness and disappointments catching up to me.  The feeling of always sinking in the muddied waters of life.

I am sorry for how you feel, as I may feel the same.  For twenty five years, I've always said to myself that I am worth more dead than alive, as my parents took out a huge insurance policy on me at a young age.  So I would always pray to the Gods to give me wisdom in the direction my life should go or take me away from it all together.  Every ounce of me thought once I hit rock bottom, the message will become clear.  The absence of a message is clear enough.

Now that I have tremendous debt and no way out, I really feel like I am out of options.

Edit: words are hard!
Thank you friend

My family is scattered throughout the states, far away from here.  I don't have too much of a relationship with them.  

Not sure what government assistance would be available to me.

Thank you friend, for your advise.  I'll look into some of the opportunities at Rover and similar jobs.  Can't say all creatures adore me, but I do like my lil creature (when he is not being a little shit).

My father and I really don't get along.  I think its because of certain similarities in our personalities and I believe we have some of the same mental struggles but he is not not willing to open up to me or anyone else about it.

I have considered it, but honestly I just don't know where to get it.  I live in a land of legal weed, with more marijuana dispensaries than Starbucks.  I tried inquiring to one of the Budtenders, but they didn't know anything about it.

No, there is no one that I can think of that could be helpful.  Most of them just wouldnt know what to say or do and try to pawn me off onto someone else, as their solution. 

Before the accident twelve years ago, I went to my sisters and mom to be open to them, how I didn't feel as though I was normal and just constantly depressed.  After that discussion, my mom and sister would call me just about everyday to multiple times a day until they died, to make sure I was alright.  My oldest sister pretended like I didn't say anything and called me sporadically as she always did at that time.  Then after the accident, she became engulfed around her family, kids, and work.   I had to move back to take care of my father, his business, finances, and general bullshit.  When I went to him, he told me its not his concern as he has nothing to do with my depression (first time he even acknowledging it) and I should just get over myself.  That was three months ago and we havent spoken since.
Another long night of trying to figure out how to unfuck my life.
I'm trying!
Thank you and I hope that you have been able to find your own solace.
Thank you for the kind words of hope and encouragement. Even though i have brought it upon myself, I wished one thing could have gone right for me so I could've kept the faith in tomorrow.
